definitions.gloss: general meeting, general assembly, plenary session
definitions.explanation: A meeting of all members of an organization, company, or body. In corporate contexts, refers specifically to a shareholders' meeting. Also used for assemblies of clubs, associations, and international organizations.

examples.japanese: {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
{年|ねん}に{一度|いちど}の{総会|そうかい}で{役員|やくいん}を{選出|せんしゅつ}する。
examples.english: Officers are elected at the once-a-year general meeting.

examples.japanese: {国連|こくれん}{総会|そうかい}で{新|あたら}しい{決議|けつぎ}が{採択|さいたく}された。
examples.english: A new resolution was adopted at the United Nations General Assembly.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common usage is {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい} (shareholders' meeting), a legally required annual meeting for corporations. Also used for any organization's plenary meeting where all members gather, such as a club or association. {国連|こくれん}{総会|そうかい} (UN General Assembly) is another well-known compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい}: shareholders' meeting
- {国連|こくれん}{総会|そうかい}: UN General Assembly
- {定期|ていき}{総会|そうかい}: regular general meeting
- {臨時|りんじ}{総会|そうかい}: extraordinary general meeting
- {総会|そうかい}を{開|ひら}く: hold a general meeting
